note: AD-135 annexes (owner 2026-09-23): an annex is extra equipment beside a building that gives it an effect. No room is kept for it: it is built only when its site beside the building is free. Each building type names its site in advance (site: the annex lot's north-west corner in the parent's own lot cells, the parent unturned; the annex turns with its parent). An annex keeps no level and must suit every level of its building. parent_level: the kept level the parent needs; research: the node that opens it (read only when the research catalogue has it).
